remarks: Welcome to Anderson Ridge! This beautifully maintained 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo in Glenbrook boasts an open and airy floor plan with plenty of natural light. The spacious living and dining area has a perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing with sliders out to your private deck. Freshly painted throughout, including the white kitchen cabinets with granite countertops and stainless steal appliances, this home is move-in ready. The bedroom features a large walk in closet and full bath located right outside the bedroom. The unit also includes a large storage room located downstairs, ideal for extra storage needs. Residents can enjoy the community amenities, including a pool, pool house, and an assigned parking spot, with plenty of guest parking available.  Complex is Investor-friendly
